issues.on_page: State Receipts -- Assessments, Interest and Grant 122,814.17
issues.issue: Line mixes assessments, interest and a grant with no breakdown. Special assessments is a reasonable guess for the dominant part but can't be confirmed (already marked review).
Printed on a State Receipts line. FEMA money is federal (probably passed through the state), so federal grants is defensible, but the form files it as state. This line is 88% of receipts.
Fiscal year end isn't printed; the extractor assumed 2025-06-30 (stated in notes).
